title: Prospective shadow cohort superseded by kill-test policy
goal: Do not precommit to a six-month prospective cohort or build its infrastructure. The bounded T002 kill test must terminate first. Even a positive T002 result may only create an independent-review request; any future prospective experiment requires a new explicitly reviewed task with its own cost and opportunity assessment.

approval.note: This task is superseded and must not be claimed or executed. A future prospective experiment requires a newly registered task and explicit review.

acceptance.assertion: No scheduled collector, six-month cohort, paper-broker adapter or prospective runtime is created under this task.
A positive T002 outcome does not reactivate T003. Any prospective study requires a new task that re-evaluates time, data and economic opportunity costs.
Supersession does not authorise paper trading, real orders, broker or wallet access, paid data, leverage or capital deployment.

supersession.reason: A mandatory 200-signal, six-month shadow programme is disproportionate before the cheap historical kill test establishes any robust signal.
